answer_1.quote: We propose DIFFUSEMP, a diffusion model-based framework, for empathetic response generation. ... Experimental results on a benchmark dataset EMPATHETICDIALOGUE show that our method outperforms competitive baselines in generating more context-related, informative, and empathetic responses.
answer_1.outputs: empathetic textual responses conditioned on dialogue context

answer_4.quote: We recruit three third-party graduate researchers (average age 23.3) to analyze the results of various models. The response quality of all models is evaluated in terms of the following three aspects: Empathy, Relevance, and Informativeness. ... Each aspect is on a scale of 1 to 5, in which 1 is "unacceptable" and 5 is "excellent performance".
answer_4.guideline: Annotators rate each generated response on a 1‑5 scale for Empathy (understanding and appropriate response), Relevance (topic relevance), and Informativeness (grammar, readability, content richness).
